senses.gloss: to hollow out, perforate, v. Hif. a. בָּרָה.
to think out, plan (cmp. בָּדָא, חָקַק); to create.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 38b:8">Snh. 38ᵇ</cite> when the Lord wanted <he>לִבְרֹאות את וכ׳</he> to create man.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 8:11">Gen. R. s. 8</cite> <he>שב׳ … ואח״כ בְּרָאוֹ</he> for He first created all the means of his support and then created him (Adam); a. v. fr.—Part. act. <cite ref="B00334"><he>בּוֹרֵא</he></cite> q. v.—Part. pass. <cite ref="B01207"><he>בָּרוּא</he></cite>, f. <he>בְּרוּאָה</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 44">Gen. R. s. 44</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 4:5">Is. IV, 5</cite> <he>וּבָרָא</he>) <he>כבר היא ב׳ וכ׳</he> it (the futurity) is already created and prepared.

senses.gloss: to be created. Ib. s. 8 אל יִבָּרֵא let him not be created.
(denom. of בַּר) to come outside, bore, perforate.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 43b:3">Ḥull. 43ᵇ</cite> <he>שמא ה׳</he> lest it (the thorn found in the throat) may have perforated (the gullet); v. infra.

senses.gloss: (denom. of בָּרִיא) to get well, recover; to be strong or stout (fat).
units: <cite ref="Meilah 17a:42">Meïl. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>יכחיש או יַבְרִיא</he> does he wish him to be lean (feeble) or to be strong?—Y. Peah III, 17ᵈ bot. <he>שמא יבריא</he> for he may get well again.
<cite ref="Chullin 33a:8">Ḥull. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>הרוצה שיַבְ׳</he> he who wants to be strong.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 19:5">Sabb. XIX, 5</cite>; a. fr. [<cite ref="Chullin 43b:3">Ḥull. 43ᵇ</cite> <he>שמא ה׳</he> lest the wound created by perforation be healed, Rashi; v. supra.]
